questions.question: Select the TWO statements that are correct according to this unit.

options.text: High availability: designing services to remain available as much as possible despite failures or disruptions.
Service-level agreement (SLA): a service availability commitment that can include an uptime guarantee.
High availability: increasing the capabilities of a resource, such as adding CPU or RAM to a virtual machine.
